[8:56AM] #Iju_Ishaga #TrafficUpdate 

Fagba Intersection is currently very busy inward Agege Pen Cinema as a result of the morning rush, while traffic flow inward Amala remains free. Movement from Jonathan Coker back to Fagba is steady this morning.

Along Iju Road down to Agege Pen Cinema, traffic is generally good, though slightly busy before the bridge. The return journey via College traffic light is smooth, and movement along Hospital Road down to African Church is also good.

Idi Agbon, Haruna, and Oyemekun corridors are experiencing good flow, though there is a slight slowdown before the traffic light at Yaya Abatan. Ajayi is moving well, with a fast return to Jungle, while inward Fagba remains smooth.

Traffic from Fagba inward Ishaga is also free, and the return journey from Ishaga up to Alamutu is fast, with steady movement back to Fagba Intersection. Officers are currently positioned at various choke points, actively managing traffic.

No impediments reported at this time, and our men are present at important locations ensuring ease of movement.

#FollowLASTMA
